This is an important poem because my mom said so.

What Is a Poem?

Parts of a poem: Stanza. Rhyme. And meaning.

If

If you can keep your head, while all about you are losing theirs. If you can trust yourself, when all men doubt you, But make allowance for their doubting too.

If you can wait, and not be tired by waiting, Or being lied about, don’t deal in lies, Or being hated, don’t give way to hating, And yet don’t look too good, nor talk too wise.
